0-250 (default 20) - Frames looked ahead when deciding slice types

0-4 (default 2) - Adaptive quantisation: 0 off, 2 auto-variance, 3 dark-scene bias, 4 edge aware
0.0-3.0 (default 1.0) - How strongly adaptive quantisation shifts QP

0.0-50.0 (default 0.0, 1.0 on slow presets) - Favours higher energy through quantisation
1-6 (default 3) - Rate-distortion optimisation level; higher looks harder
0.5-1.0 (default 0.6) - Quantiser curve compression; 1.0 behaves like constant QP
